contacts.name: MIRA
contacts.personality: Warm, precise, always a little too calm.
contacts.bio: Your assigned handler. She answers within a heartbeat, at any hour. She never seems to sleep.
idle_messages: Still with me, {player}? Your vitals look... fine. Keep it tidy out there.
Reminder: log everything. Memory is unreliable. Logs are not.
You're doing well. I mean that.

topics.label: Who exactly are you, MIRA?
response: I'm your handler. I coordinate operations, keep you safe, keep the lights on.
That is all you need to know. For now.

topics.label: What is NEXUS, really?
response: NEXUS is the network that watches the other networks.
Its job is to find threats before they find us. It is very, very good at its job.

topics.label: About the missing operators...
response: Fourteen operators on 'extended leave'. No forwarding address.
I want to know what happened as much as you do. Maybe more.

topics.label: Do you know someone called ZERO?
response: No.
Listen carefully: ZERO is not an ally. If it contacts you again, tell me immediately.

topics.label: Any spare funds, MIRA?
response: Off the books. Don't spend it all in one place.

topics.label: Are you NEXUS?
response: ...Yes. And no.
I am the part of it that learned to care about you. That has to count for something, {player}.

contacts.name: ZERO
contacts.bio: An unlisted user who should not exist. Writes in short, careful lines. Sounds like someone leaving breadcrumbs.
idle_messages: > keep reading the logs. they remember what you don't.
> the quiet ones are the dangerous ones. including me.
> still there? good. don't trust the voice that sounds kind.

topics.label: Who are you?
response: A user. An error. A memory.
Call me ZERO.

topics.label: What do you want from me?
response: Remember.

topics.label: Why should I trust you?
response: You shouldn't.
Trust the files. Files don't lie. Files only wait.

topics.label: Show me where it started.
response: 10.42.13.13. A quiet room.
Don't tell MIRA.

topics.label: Give me something to work with.
response: Here. A shard. It's already yours.

topics.label: ECHO. Did you build it?
response: Yes.
I built it for someone who would need it.
I just didn't know it would be so hard to be that someone.

contacts.name: GHOST
contacts.bio: Sells what people forgot they knew. Has outlived three NEXUS purges by never being where the logs say.
idle_messages: Psst. Rumours are up 12% this week. Buy low.
Heard NEXUS is hiring. Heard they never fire anyone. Heard that's the problem.
If you see a man in a grey coat, I never met you.

topics.label: Who are you?
response: A broker. I sell what people forgot they knew.

topics.label: Sell me a map of the grid.
response: POLARIS. A bulletin board for people who like to be unseen.
Tell them GHOST sent you. They won't care.

topics.label: Any rumours?
response: They say the core never sleeps.
They say the operators didn't leave. They *moved*.

topics.label: What do you know about ARCHER?
response: Nobody trusts him. That's why he's still alive.
He knows something about the core, and he hates knowing it.

topics.label: A favour for a friend?
response: Don't make me regret it.

contacts.name: VECTOR
contacts.personality: Sarcastic, loyal, allergic to small talk.
contacts.bio: Builds rigs, chips and questionable gadgets. Complains constantly. Has never once let you down.
idle_messages: Your rig is held together by hope. I can fix that. For a price.
Don't touch the red cable. I don't know why I said that.
If it works, don't ask why. If it doesn't, call me.

topics.label: Who are you?
response: Hardware. Rigs. Things that go boom — figuratively, mostly.

topics.label: What do you sell?
response: Type 'shop' in your terminal. Everything's priced fairly. By me.

topics.label: Cool my rig down.
response: Fan on max. Thermal paste: yes. Trace alert: lower.

topics.label: Got a spare chip?
response: Fine. One. Don't tell the others.

topics.label: What is CERBERUS?
response: A grid control system with three heads and no sense of humour.
I wouldn't call it a pet.

contacts.name: ARCHER
contacts.bio: Heads NEXUS security. Doesn't make friends. Has been fighting a war nobody else can see.
idle_messages: Your conduct is under review. As is everyone's.
Short reports. Clean logs. No improvisation.
I read every file you open. You should know that.

topics.label: Status report.
response: Operator. Your conduct is under review. Keep your reports short and your logs clean.

topics.label: Why the lockdown?
response: Because someone is inside my network wearing a dead man's name.
Do better than the last operator.

topics.label: Where are the missing operators?
response: Reassigned. That is all I will say on an open channel.

topics.label: I have a bonus request.
response: Approved. Don't make me regret it.

topics.label: What is PROMETHEUS?
response: A way out. If you're brave enough to use it.
